thread:
sam-marketing: Heads-up: scheduled publish for the "Optimize v2" benchmarking post is up in 30m. Quick sanity check before we go live?

elaine: Thanks. Can someone confirm the Dedicated memory profiles? I saw an alert from the perf monitor earlier.

ops-bot: Perf monitor: elevated memory spike detected on pool-dedicated-4 during 32k runs (2026-07-24T15:12:07Z). Spike magnitude: +28% above baseline.

mike-eng: I saw that too. It's reproducible locally when KV cache retention is enabled with batch>1. We've got an extra allocation path that wasn't guarded for large context.

devon-analyst: The published CSV in the PR currently uses runs with KV cache disabled for long-context. The text calls these "production-like cache settings" which is inconsistent.

sam-marketing: That's a problem. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/content/pull/1492 lists the assets. Can we pause the publish? The CMS shows auto-publish at 2026-07-24 16:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Auto-publish scheduled for 2026-07-24 16:00 UTC (job 99321). Queuing hold.

nina-pr: If we pause, I need a short statement to the embargo list in case reporters ping. Draft: "We are verifying final performance data for accuracy; publication will be delayed briefly." Any objections?

mike-eng: No objection. I'll open a focused run with KV cache on and batch=1 to match the claimed configuration. Will annotate run params and push a corrected CSV to s3://benchmarks/optimize_v2/ by EOD ~20m.

devon-analyst: I'll generate the corrected charts after the run completes. Also will add an appendix table in the post that clearly lists run config per chart.

sam-marketing: Good. Please also flag any change to the headline metric in the PR comments so we don't accidentally ship stale copy. Editors: do not merge until Nina signs off.

press-outreach: I've queued an embargo note: "Delayed briefly for data verification. Expect updated post within the hour." Sending to embargoes list now.

elaine: One more ask: add one sentence to the post explaining what changed (cache enabled vs disabled) so external readers aren't confused by the revision history.

mike-eng: Will include a short technical note and the kernel flags used. Starting runs now: job 5588. ETA ~17m.

devon-analyst: Charts pipeline running on the new CSV when available. Will push images to the PR under assets/figures_v2. Leaving a comment when done.

ops-bot: Publish job 99321 paused.

nina-pr: I'll hold the final signoff until I see the updated charts and a one-liner from Eng confirming the config. If everything checks out, we can release at 2026-07-24 17:15 UTC.

sam-marketing: Thanks everyone. I'll stand by and update the CMS meta when we confirm. :thumbsup:
